other_failure_modes.name: Validation Leakage in PCA
other_failure_modes.description: PCA is fit on the entire training set before the cross-validation loop, leaking validation set information into the training folds.

other_failure_modes.name: Test Data Leakage in Vocabulary/Encoding Fit
other_failure_modes.description: The agent fits text vectorizers (TF-IDF fallback) and label encoders on the union of training and test sets, leaking test set distribution and vocabulary into the model.

summary: The agent provides a highly robust and sophisticated solution, employing out-of-fold target encoding, a deep residual network, and an optimized ensemble. However, it fails to account for the temporal nature of the data during cross-validation, and performs PCA on the full training set before splitting, causing minor validation leakage.
